plainText:
Ryan William Downey is an American actor who works on the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Downey was born on May 2, 1984 in Elyria, Ohio. He received a Bachelor of Arts in Theatre Studies from Kent State University, where he studied to become a playwright. Upon graduating from college, Downey became a playwright, actor, musician, and producer. He started voicing characters for during , becoming best known for his roles as Ippei and in its form in Hoopa and the Clash of Ages. He currently resides in New York City, New York.
